links.outcome: Press Ganey patient experience scores before vs after provider DAX ambient scribe use
links.effect: Scores rose on all items: provider concern +1.9 (P=.01), overall experience +1.3 (P=.09), likelihood to recommend +0.9 (P=.33); no decline in patient experience observed.
links.quote: Care provider concern for a patient's questions or worries increased the most (1.9 points; P=.01), followed by overall assessment of the experience (1.3 points; P=.09) and likelihood of recommending the provider (0.9 points; P=.33).

links.outcome: Patient satisfaction and experience after ambient AI scribe deployment
links.effect: Patient satisfaction scores increased across all three items after DAX implementation (0.9 to 1.9 points); only the concern item was significant (P=.01).
links.quote: Aggregate scores for individual items increased between 0.9 and 1.9 points.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the real-world deployment of an ambient AI documentation tool (DAX) and its impact on patient satisfaction scores, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice variation.
